blocks.html: The Iloilo Dinagyang Festival is one of the Philippines’ most spectacular and colorful festivals. It showcases the rich heritage and beautiful history of the indigenous people while celebrating in honor of the Santo Niño. As one of many key festivals on the island country, there is a very reason why you should make efforts to attend this one!

And the presence of Maja Salvador January 24 (Friday), heats up the festivities at Robinsons Place Jaro with her sizzling and jaw-dropping performances. Mall-goers will surely be stunned as she fires up a storm on the stage at the mall’s Artium.

Don’t miss the opportunity to interact and pose for a photo with Maja! RLC’s ambassadress is eager to once again personally meet and bond with the first 150 lucky fans by presenting a single/accumulated receipt worth P1000 from any shop at Robinsons Place Jaro.
